name: Maid no An'yo ni Makete wa Ikenai
original_name: メイドのあんよに負けてはいけない
source:
During your heroic journey, you are summoned to a large castle to receive a reward for your work.

Awaiting you is a room with two maids looks to give you a massage...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ292132.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在英雄的旅途中，你受召前往一座宏伟的城堡，领取为功绩准备的奖赏。

等待你的，是一间房间，以及两位打算为你按摩的女仆……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ292132.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
